item.title: SK Innovation to lead US$2.3 billion LNG mega project in Vietnam
item.description: SK Innovation has been selected to lead a landmark LNG power project in Nghe An Province, Vietnam.

item.title: INPEX granted environmental approval for Abadi LNG project
item.description: INPEX CORP. has received environmental approval for the Abadi LNG project from the government of Indonesia.

item.title: Uniper and GSPC sign long-term LNG supply agreement
item.description: Uniper and GSPC have finalised an up to 10-year LNG agreement for deliveries of up to 0.5 million tpy into India.

item.title: Technip Energies awarded contract for Coral Norte floating LNG project
item.description: Technip Energies, in partnership with JGC and Samsung Heavy Industries, has been awarded a contract by Mozambique Rovuma Venture to progress the work on the Coral Norte floating LNG project, located offshore Mozambique.

item.title: LNG Canada achieves 50 cargoes
item.description: LNG Canada and its joint venture participants have marked the departure of the 50th cargo from the facility in Kitimat, British Columbia.

item.title: Naftogaz secures first ever delivery of LNG via Germany terminal
item.description: Naftogaz Group has secured the supply of US LNG via Deutsche ReGas’s LNG terminal located on the island of Rügen, Germany, in the Baltic Sea.

item.title: Centrica Energy and Whitecap enter long-term natural gas supply agreement
item.description: Centrica Energy has announced the signing of a long-term natural gas purchase agreement with Whitecap Resources Inc.

item.title: Japan’s LNG resales set new records despite looming oversupply in global markets
item.description: Japan’s resales of LNG to foreign markets continued to reach new highs in fiscal year 2024, up nearly 15% compared to the previous year.

item.title: EIA: 10 years after first Sabine Pass cargo, US LNG exports are still on the rise
item.description: Today, the US is the world’s largest LNG exporter, ahead of both Australia and Qatar, with LNG exports surged from 0.5 billion ft3/d in 2016 to 15 billion ft3/d in 2025, reports the U.S. Energy Information Administration.

item.title: Shell and METLEN sign agreement for co-operation in LNG supply and trading
item.description: Shell and METLEN have signed a memorandum of understanding, establishing a framework for co-operation in the supply and trading of LNG.
